# Every table the schema creates, with the schema version that introduced it
# (schema_lock_check_test.go, Epic #5978).
#
# Each line is <table> <version>. New tables add a line with the current
# SchemaVersion in the same change that adds their CREATE TABLE; the check fails for a
# table with no line. Existing lines are never edited: a table's version is the fact
# that makes a schema:new-table marker valid, so it must not change.
